page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance configured within the KVM hypervisor framework. It features 2 dedicated physical CPU cores with 1 thread per core, resulting in 2 virtual CPUs. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. There is no local NVMe or SSD storage bundled with this instance, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance does not include any GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The CPU configuration lacks advanced instruction set extensions such as AVX, AVX512, AMX, and SHA-NI cryptographic acceleration. This absence of specialized hardware vector and matrix instructions limits the instance's performance in high-performance computing, deep learning inference, and heavy cryptographic operations. However, the dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without the resource contention typical of shared-core or burstable instances. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a standard entry-level option for workloads requiring stable, predictable baseline performance without the premium cost of specialized compute or memory-optimized hardware.

Given its balanced resource profile and lack of specialized hardware accelerators, the ecs.s2.xlarge is suited for general-purpose workloads. Appropriate use cases include hosting low-traffic web servers, running lightweight application servers, managing small development or testing environments, and executing basic background utility tasks that do not demand intensive parallel processing or high disk I/O.
